programme.title: Just for Showmance
programme.desc: Hoping to boost her career, a celebrity agrees to go on a reality TV show to marry her perfect match, a man she's never met. She soon tries to track him down to clarify that the marriage is just for show. (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: The Boyfriend Trap
programme.desc: Identical twins Alice and Lacey are mistaken for each other on a retreat. They decide to go with it just for the trip, soon they realize that they may have been wrong about who and what they needed in their lives all along. (Romance)

programme.title: See Jane Date
programme.desc: To impress her high-school nemesis (Holly Marie Combs), a woman (Charisma Carpenter) searches for the perfect man to bring to an upcoming wedding. (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: A Priceless Love
programme.desc: Rose McGovern realizes that one of the items in her secondhand store is actually an antique teapot worth $80K. An ambitious antique broker tries to buy the piece from her, but she's determined to find the original owner. (Romance)

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye - A Blast From the Past
programme.desc: A criminal Dimitrius put behind bars for 10 years gets released with revenge in mind against those who imprisoned him and their families. (Crime drama)

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye - Silent Night
programme.desc: Sue clashes with her visiting mom over holiday preparations, leaving her dad and Lucy stuck in the middle. (Crime drama)

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye - Greed
programme.desc: Sue persuades a frightened employee to work with the FBI, but they both find their careers and their lives in danger. (Crime drama)

programme.title: A Bestselling Kind of Love
programme.desc: Nora is thrilled when her first novel soars to the top of the bestsellers list but is terrified of speaking in front of crowds to promote it. Her agent hires Daniel, a public speaking coach, to help her overcome her fears. (Romance)

programme.title: A Bet With the Matchmaker
programme.desc: A relationship columnist on the brink of losing her job makes a bet with a self-proclaimed matchmaker who guarantees he'll find her perfect match. (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Romantic Rewrite

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as the Coast Guard launches a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life. - Naomi Watts, Bill Murray, Ann Dowd, Constance Wu, Sarah Pidgeon (Drama)

programme.title: The Doors
programme.desc: After a psychedelic experience in the California desert, Jim Morrison (Val Kilmer), lead singer of The Doors, and his bandmates begin performing in Los Angeles and quickly become a sensation. However, when Jim begins ditching his musical responsibilities and his girlfriend, Pamela (Meg Ryan), in favor of his dangerous addictions and the affections of the seductive, occult-obsessed Patricia (Kathleen Quinlan), the band starts to worry about their leader. - Val Kilmer, Meg Ryan, Kevin Dillon, Kyle MacLachlan, Frank Whaley (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Rock)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. - Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz, Susan Sarandon, Stanley Tucci, Michael Imperioli (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: My Boss's Daughter
programme.desc: A misunderstanding leads Tom Stansfield (Ashton Kutcher), a mild-mannered publishing house employee, to house-sit for his boss, Jack Taylor (Terence Stamp), instead of Jack's daughter, Lisa (Tara Reid), who goes partying. While Lisa is away, her older brother hides some drugs in the bathroom, which the family's pet owl ingests, causing it to behave erratically. Lisa comes home and starts to take a liking to Tom, but the situation is interrupted by an upset drug dealer and other mayhem. - Ashton Kutcher, Tara Reid, Jeffrey Tambor, Andy Richter, Michael Madsen (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression. - Margot Robbie, Travis Fimmel, Garrett Hedlund, Kerry Condon, Finn Cole (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. - Amanda Bynes, James Kirk, Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, Emily Perkins (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood. - Jojo Bapteise Whiting, LaDainian Crazy Thunder, Ashley Shelton, Robert Stover, Jesse Schmockel (Drama)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression. - Margot Robbie, Travis Fimmel, Garrett Hedlund, Kerry Condon, Finn Cole (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. - Kristen Stewart, Steven Yeun (Romance, Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average. - Colin Hanks, Jack Black, Catherine O'Hara, Schuyler Fisk, John Lithgow (Comedy, Drama)

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: A chameleon who has lived as a sheltered family pet finds himself in the grip of an identity crisis. Rango wonders how to stand out when it is his nature to blend in. When he accidentally winds up in a frontier town called Dirt, he takes the first step on a transformational journey as the town's new sheriff. Though at first Rango only role-plays, a series of thrilling situations and outrageous encounters forces him to become a real hero. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Mean Creek
programme.desc: Quiet adolescent Sam (Rory Culkin) has been bullied by George (Josh Peck), a fellow student who has trouble fitting in with other teens. When Rocky (Trevor Morgan), Sam's elder brother, finds out Sam is being picked on, he enlists his buddies to help get back at George. They ask George to accompany them on a boating expedition deep in the woods, but when their plan to humiliate George horrifically backfires, the friends make a series of poor decisions that will change their lives. - Rory Culkin, Ryan Kelley, Scott Mechlowicz, Trevor Morgan, Josh Peck (Drama)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America

programme.title: You Gotta Eat Here! - Queen Bee Cafe; Bon Temps Cafe; The Borough
programme.desc: At Queen Bee in Seattle, John gets his crumpwich on; John drops by Saskatoon's Bons Temps Café for some Cajun cuisine; John tries a Yorkshire pudding burger at Toronto's Borough. (Food)

programme.title: You Gotta Eat Here! - Izabel's; Deacon's Corner; Two Dishes Cookshop
programme.desc: John gets some breakfast at Deacon's Corner in Vancouver; Peterborough's Two Dishes Cookshop serves up some hearty home cooking; at Izabel's in Waterdown, Ontario, John tries some schnitzel. (Food)

programme.title: You Gotta Eat Here! - Burger Edition
programme.desc: Featuring lobster burgers and Thanksgiving dinner burgers. (Food)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Beachside Delights
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer hosts a beach rental baking competition; ten bakers craft faux ice cream bars and cocktail tarts; judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman, and Damaris Phillips savor summer-inspired creations before they select the champion. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Summer Cruise
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer's cruise baking contest features vibrant inner tube cakes and snorkeling-themed cheesecakes for judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman, and Damaris Phillips to evaluate. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Summer Lake Adventure
programme.desc: While fueling up at a lakeside hotel breakfast buffet, Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to make sweet and savory breakfast treats; Jesse has been picking berries by the lake, and it's the bakers' job to turn them into summer pies. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Summer Feelings
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer uses Disney and Pixar's. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - We're Going Glamping
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer uses his ideal road snack, a chocolate bar, to challenge the bakers with creating road trip portable desserts; the bakers go glamping as they cook up glam summer cobbler desserts before the judges decide who takes a hike. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Southwest Summer Break
programme.desc: Cruising through the American Southwest, Jesse Palmer tasks the bakers with creating sweet and handheld dessert tacos. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Shark Week Sweets
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer celebrates Discovery's Shark Week on the sandy shores by challenging the bakers to make shark bite cookie bars in the shape of beach items. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship - Big Apple Fireworks
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer lands in the Big Apple for some finale fireworks and the bakers create red, white and woo-hoo desserts for his backyard BBQ; the one baker who can blow the judges away with their exploding fireworks cake will take home the $25,000 prize. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show: The Professionals - The Semi Final
programme.desc: An intense semifinal round challenges four teams with crafting sweet-and-savory petits fours as well as jelly desserts fit for a teddy bear's picnic. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Chocolat! - Chocolate Loves Flavour
programme.desc: Rachel explores chocolate's versatility; she mixes it with savory in a polpette penne; in Stockholm, she learns about pairing drink with chocolate. - Rachel Khoo (Food)

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Chocolat! - Indulgence
programme.desc: Rachel Khoo explores why chocolate is so irresistible and creates her favorite indulgent treats; Rachel meets Lana Citron, and they explore why chocolate and desire are so entwined. - Rachel Khoo (Food)

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show: The Professionals - The Semi Final
programme.desc: An intense semifinal round challenges four teams with crafting sweet-and-savory petits fours as well as jelly desserts fit for a teddy bear's picnic. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Chocolat! - Chocolate Loves Flavour
programme.desc: Rachel explores chocolate's versatility; she mixes it with savory in a polpette penne; in Stockholm, she learns about pairing drink with chocolate. - Rachel Khoo (Food)

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Relay: All-Star Moms vs. Dads
programme.desc: Guy Fieri invites three all-star chef moms and three all-star chef dads to a team relay showdown; the teammates work on their dish one at a time in shifts. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Relay: Winners vs. Judges
programme.desc: Guy Fieri hosts a team competition between three previous winners and three judges; working one at a time, only the first chef is told that they're making a seafood platter, while the remaining chefs will have to guess what they're preparing. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - Relay: Ultimate Face-Off
programme.desc: Guy Fieri sets up the ultimate face-off with a relay between two teams to create a spicy champion's dinner; working blind, the chefs in the latter shifts cook and present dishes based on their best guess of what the teammate before them was making. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games - DDD Vegan
programme.desc: Guy Fieri invites four DDD chefs with vegan joints to compete in Flavortown Market; they make their vegan bestseller using only nine pounds of groceries before serving up a meat-free steakhouse dinner. (Food, Game Shows)

programme.desc: Four chefs compete in a battle celebrating Chinese cuisine; they scramble to distinguish themselves when prompted to make similar appetizers, showcase their unique style with an impressive salmon entrée and craft a dessert from noodles and candy. (Christmas, Food)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: With help from trainer Kevin Rooney, champion boxer Vinny Pazienza tries to make a comeback after breaking his neck in a car accident.

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Machine Gun Preacher
programme.desc: Sam Childers (Gerard Butler), a former biker, decides to go to East Africa to help repair homes destroyed by civil war. Transformed by the horrors he sees, Sam ignores the warnings of more experienced aide workers and breaks ground for an orphanage in the heart of territory controlled by a brutal renegade militia. But establishing a shelter is not enough; determined to save as many lives as possible, Sam leads armed missions into enemy territory to rescue kidnapped children. - Gerard Butler, Michelle Monaghan, Michael Shannon, Kathy Baker, Souléymane Sy Savané (Biography, Crime drama, Action)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: When Johnny (Al Pacino) is released from prison following a forgery charge, he quickly lands a job as a short-order cook at a New York diner. Following a brief fling with waitress Cora (Kate Nelligan), Frankie develops an attraction for Cora's friend and fellow waitress Frankie (Michelle Pfeiffer). While Frankie resists Johnny's charms initially, she eventually relents when her best friend, Tim (Nathan Lane), persuades her to give Johnny a chance. - Al Pacino, Michelle Pfeiffer, Héctor Elizondo, Nathan Lane, Kate Nelligan (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis. - Seth Green, Breckin Meyer, Brenda Song, Clare Grant, Macaulay Culkin (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. - Tom Cruise, Penélope Cruz, Cameron Diaz, Kurt Russell, Jason Lee (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: For Greater Glory: The True Story of Cristiada
programme.desc: In late 1920s Mexico, retired Gen. Gorostieta and his wife watch their country degenerate into violent civil war when the government enacts a series of anti-clerical laws. Gorostieta is at first hesitant to join the rebels, known as Cristeros, until he begins to see the cost of religious persecution on his countrymen. Though the odds are against him, the general nevertheless transforms a ragtag band of rebels into a formidable fighting force. - Andy Garcia, Eva Longoria, Peter O'Toole, Oscar Isaac, Santiago Cabrera (Historical drama)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder. - Mark Wahlberg, Joaquin Phoenix, Charlize Theron, James Caan, Ellen Burstyn (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Literature professor Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) leads a secret life as a high-stakes gambler. Always a risk-taker, Bennett bets it all when he borrows from a gangster and offers his own life as collateral. Staying one step ahead, he pits his creditor against the operator of an illicit gambling ring while garnering the attention of Frank (John Goodman), a paternalistic loan shark. As his relationship with a student (Brie Larson) deepens, Bennett must risk everything for a second chance. - Mark Wahlberg, John Goodman, Brie Larson, Michael Kenneth Williams, Jessica Lange (Crime drama)

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily. - Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Walter Alza, Serena Reeder, Benz Antoine (Crime drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap, Action)

programme.title: Get Hard
programme.desc: When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other. - Will Ferrell, Kevin Hart, Craig T. Nelson, Alison Brie, Edwina Findley (Comedy)

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: Obsessed with bringing terrorist Castor Troy (Nicolas Cage) to justice, FBI agent Sean Archer (John Travolta) tracks down Troy, who has boarded a plane in Los Angeles. After the plane crashes and Troy is severely injured, possibly dead, Archer undergoes surgery to remove his face and replace it with Troy's. As Archer tries to use his disguise to elicit information about a bomb from Troy's brother, Troy awakes from a coma and forces the doctor who performed the surgery to give him Archer's face. - John Travolta, Nicolas Cage, Joan Allen, Alessandro Nivola, Gina Gershon (Action, Crime drama)

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe). - Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan, Charlotte Le Bon, Anna Geislerová, Toby Jones (Historical drama, War, Thriller)

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Literature professor Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) leads a secret life as a high-stakes gambler. Always a risk-taker, Bennett bets it all when he borrows from a gangster and offers his own life as collateral. Staying one step ahead, he pits his creditor against the operator of an illicit gambling ring while garnering the attention of Frank (John Goodman), a paternalistic loan shark. As his relationship with a student (Brie Larson) deepens, Bennett must risk everything for a second chance. - Mark Wahlberg, John Goodman, Brie Larson, Michael Kenneth Williams, Jessica Lange (Crime drama)

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. - Goldie Hawn, Bette Midler, Diane Keaton, Maggie Smith, Sarah Jessica Parker (Comedy)

programme.title: Faster
programme.desc: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. - Dwayne Johnson, Billy Bob Thornton, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Carla Gugino, Maggie Grace (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: The Dutchman
programme.desc: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. - André Holland, Kate Mara, Zazie Beetz, Stephen McKinley Henderson, Aldis Hodge (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation. - Dan Bakkedahl, Kevin Dillon, Josh Duhamel, James Roday Rodriguez, Nick Swardson (Comedy)

programme.title: Waking Up in Reno
programme.desc: Candy (Charlize Theron) and Lonnie Earl (Billy Bob Thornton) are just crazy about each other. The problem: she's married to Roy (Patrick Swayze) and he's married to Darlene (Natasha Richardson). So far it's been a secret affair. But that's about to change, because this foursome is driving cross-country and headed for some big surprises. - Billy Bob Thornton, Charlize Theron, Natasha Richardson, Patrick Swayze, Holmes Osborne (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. - Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jon Bernthal, Jon Hamm (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims.

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: Cryptic notes and encounters with a mysterious stranger torment a drill-press operator (Christian Bale) who has not slept in a year.

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: A police inspector (Nick Nolte) suspects a law student (Ewan McGregor) or his friend (Josh Brolin) of serial killings and eerie events at the city morgue.

programme.title: The Dutchman
programme.desc: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head travel from Las Vegas to Washington, D.C., not realizing that their landlord has sent them to kill his wife.

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: Three childhood friends (Seth Green, Matthew Lillard, Dax Shepard) embark on a canoe trip to find a plane hijacker's stash of money.

programme.title: Without a Paddle: Nature's Calling
programme.desc: Two friends (Oliver James, Kristopher Turner) and a crazy Briton (Rik Young) have wild misadventures while searching for a missing girl in the woods.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: The damaged denizens of Sin City return for another round of stories from the mind of Frank Miller. In "Just Another Saturday Night," Marv (Mickey Rourke) struggles to recall a nasty run-in with some frat boys. In "A Dame to Kill For," Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) forsakes his battle with his inner demons to help Ava Lord (Eva Green), the woman of his dreams and nightmares. In "Nancy's Last Dance," Nancy Callahan (Jessica Alba), mad with grief and rage over Hartigan's death, vows revenge. - Mickey Rourke, Jessica Alba, Josh Brolin, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Rosario Dawson (Action, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. - Deanna Jarvis, Derick Agyemang, Kylee Evans, Jonathan Goad, Ish Morris (Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Gillian Jacobs, Eddie Marsan, JD Pardo (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden. - Kevin James, Christina Ricci, Luis Guzmán, Melissa Leo, Francis Cronin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Peter Graves, Robert Stack, Lloyd Bridges (Dark comedy)

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. - Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Lloyd Bridges, Peter Graves, William Shatner (Science fiction, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Buddy Games: Spring Awakening
programme.desc: Faced with their biggest challenge yet, the gang sets out to honor a lost pal, only to find themselves in the middle of where it all began -- spring break. They soon learn their old school ways of partying can hardly compete with today's generation. - Dan Bakkedahl, Kevin Dillon, Josh Duhamel, James Roday Rodriguez, Nick Swardson (Comedy)

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers. - Will Brittain, Zoey Deutch, Ryan Guzman, Tyler Hoechlin, Blake Jenner (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Heather Graham (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: It's been two years since the gang known as the Wolfpack narrowly escaped disaster in Bangkok. Now, Phil (Bradley Cooper), Stu (Ed Helms) and Doug (Justin Bartha) have happy lives at home -- but Alan (Zach Galifianakis) doesn't. Still lacking contentment and a sense of purpose, Alan has gone off his meds and surrendered to his natural impulses. It's up to the other members of the Wolfpack to get him through his personal crisis by embarking on a road trip to the place it all began: Las Vegas. - Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis, Justin Bartha, Ken Jeong (Comedy)

programme.title: Staten Island Summer
programme.desc: Danny and Frank work as lifeguards for the summer and make plans to throw the wildest party of the season. - Ashley Greene, Kate Walsh, Gina Gershon, Jim Gaffigan, Graham Phillips (Comedy)

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule. - Sacha Baron Cohen, Anna Faris, Ben Kingsley, Jason Mantzoukas, Kevin Corrigan (Comedy)

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: After their friend Billy (Anthony Starr) dies, Tom (Dax Shepard), Jerry (Matthew Lillard) and Dan (Seth Green) go on a camping trip to honor his memory. The campsite, however, has special significance. Billy believed famous airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper hid money in the area, and his friends aim to find it. Unfortunately, they are not prepared for the adventure. After falling over a waterfall, they are left to the mercy of wild animals and a harsh wilderness terrain. - Seth Green, Matthew Lillard, Dax Shepard, Ethan Suplee, Abraham Benrubi (Comedy, Adventure, Mystery)

programme.title: Without a Paddle: Nature's Calling
programme.desc: Two friends (Oliver James, Kristopher Turner) and a crazy Briton (Rik Young) have wild misadventures while searching for a missing girl in the woods. - Oliver James, Kristopher Turner, Rik Young, Amber McDonald, Madison Riley (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis. - Seth Green, Breckin Meyer, Brenda Song, Clare Grant, Macaulay Culkin (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: In the 25th century, the Earth's population has dwindled to a surviving five million following a devastating virus that almost resulted in the extinction of all human life 400 years earlier. Confined to one city-state, a group of rebels, led by Handler (Frances McDormand), seeks to destroy the oppressive government -- first, by assassinating a high-ranking chairman (Marton Csokas). Tasked with this mission, Aeon Flux (Charlize Theron) must integrate herself in a world of deceit and mystery. - Charlize Theron, Marton Csokas, Jonny Lee Miller, Sophie Okonedo, Frances McDormand (Science fiction, Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: A physician (Samantha Morton) who keeps her dying son completely secluded becomes unhinged when she learns that her new neighbor (Natasha Calis) has secretly befriended the boy. - Samantha Morton, Michael Shannon, Natasha Calis, Charlie Tahan, Peter Fonda (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. - Betsy Palmer, Adrienne King, Harry Crosby, Laurie Bartram, Mark Nelson (Horror)

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. - Amy Steel, John Furey, Adrienne King, Kirsten Baker, Stuart Charno (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin, Woody Harrelson, Kelly Macdonald (Crime drama, Thriller, Western)

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war. - Dylan O'Brien, Michael Keaton, Sanaa Lathan, David Suchet, Navid Negahban (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world. - John Goodman, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, John Gallagher Jr., Douglas M. Griffin, Suzanne Cryer (Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: A hardworking man's inability to say no to a beautiful woman gets him in trouble when he agrees to steal $68,000.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter (Colin Farrell) finds himself inadvertently entangled in the criminal underworld when his knucklehead friends (Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell) abduct a mobster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate a fortified church and destroy a Nazi transmitter. Making their way to an underground lab, the soldiers stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a battle against an army of the undead.

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Picard (Patrick Stewart), Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and the others set off to stop the half-robot Borg from sabotaging the first warp drive flight in 2063.

programme.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
programme.desc: A Caribbean vampire seeks the half-vampire, half-human New York homicide detective destined to be his bride.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything. - Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Scarlett Johansson, Julianne Moore, Tony Danza, Glenne Headley (Comedy drama, Romance)

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education. - Lilly Singh, Sonia Dhillon Tully, Sabrina Jalees, Ana Gasteyer, Stephanie Beatriz (Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. - Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Emma Roberts, Mary McDonnell (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning. - Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh, Natasha Lyonne, Paul Hipp, Anita Pallenberg (Drama, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt). - Mel Gibson, Helen Hunt, Marisa Tomei, Mark Feuerstein, Lauren Holly (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes. (Anthology)

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: When Johnny (Al Pacino) is released from prison following a forgery charge, he quickly lands a job as a short-order cook at a New York diner. Following a brief fling with waitress Cora (Kate Nelligan), Frankie develops an attraction for Cora's friend and fellow waitress Frankie (Michelle Pfeiffer). While Frankie resists Johnny's charms initially, she eventually relents when her best friend, Tim (Nathan Lane), persuades her to give Johnny a chance. - Al Pacino, Michelle Pfeiffer, Héctor Elizondo, Nathan Lane, Kate Nelligan (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Stephanie Zinone (Michelle Pfeiffer) is the leader of Rydell High School's Pink Ladies, a gang of girls who are counterparts of the school's group of greasers called the T-Birds. Stephanie is tired of her relationship with top T-Bird Johnny Nogerelli (Adrian Zmed), so she breaks up with him and quickly catches the eye of English exchange student Michael Carrington (Maxwell Caulfield). Hoping to win her over, Michael tries to overcome his nerdy ways while holding off the jealous Johnny. - Maxwell Caulfield, Michelle Pfeiffer, Pamela Segall, Didi Conn, Eve Arden (Musical, Romance, Comedy)

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: As death row inmate Matthew Poncelet (Sean Penn) nears his execution date, he calls upon Sister Helen Prejean (Susan Sarandon) to help him with one last appeal, maintaining that he is innocent of the murders of a young couple. Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. As things begin to look bleak for Poncelet, Prejean does all that she can to comfort and console the hardened convict. - Susan Sarandon, Sean Penn, Robert Prosky, Raymond J. Barry, R. Lee Ermey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation. - Harrison Ford, Kelly McGillis, Alexander Godunov, Josef Sommer, Lukas Haas (Crime drama, Romance, Thriller)

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. - Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant, Colin Firth, Jim Broadbent, Gemma Jones (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too. - Harrison Ford, Julia Ormond, Greg Kinnear, Nancy Marchand, John Wood (Romantic comedy, Drama)

programme.title: The King's Speech
programme.desc: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence. - Colin Firth, Geoffrey Rush, Helena Bonham Carter, Guy Pearce, Timothy Spall (Historical drama, Biography)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: An accident connects four groups of people on three different continents: two young Moroccan goatherds, a vacationing American couple (Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett), a deaf Japanese teen and her father, and a Mexican nanny who takes her young charges across a border without parental permission. - Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett, Gael García Bernal, Kôji Yakusho, Adriana Barraza (Drama)

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. - Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, M.C. Gainey, Jack Noseworthy (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Run

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her. - Scarlett Johansson, Pilou Asbæk, "Beat" Takeshi Kitano, Michael Carmen Pitt, Juliette Binoche (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Hard Truths
programme.desc: Pansy, angry and depressed, lashes out at family and strangers. Her constant criticism isolates her, except from her cheerful sister Chantelle, who remains sympathetic despite their differences. - Marianne Jean-Baptiste, Michele Austin, David Webber, Tuwaine Barrett, Sophia Brown (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Mark Harelik (Comedy, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Heartbreak Kid
programme.desc: After a short fling with a beautiful woman named Lila (Malin Akerman) and at the urging of his friends and family, Eddie (Ben Stiller) proposes marriage. But Eddie didn't realize that Lila is a shrew, and she reveals her true nature during their honeymoon. He then meets Miranda (Michelle Monaghan) and is convinced she is his soul mate. Eddie sets out to woo Miranda and extricate himself from his wife's claws. - Ben Stiller, Michelle Monaghan, Jerry Stiller, Malin Akerman, Carlos Mencia (Comedy, Romance)

programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel. - Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Parker Posey, Greg Kinnear, Jean Stapleton (Drama, Romance, Comedy)
